A brief notice about welfare walks
It is for travelers

Welfare Walks for Traveling Pets

Travelers should check in with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure so we can review basic care needs and help plan a smooth trip with Aurelia Skyways.

Our team supports animals from booking through pickup, and we keep the process calm and clear. <<FACT F082>> Please bring the usual travel papers, carry the right crate or carrier, and share any comfort notes that may help the animal settle. If your pet is nervous, let us know early so the welfare coordinator can suggest simple steps that may help.

For larger dogs, please ask about the travel fee and any boarding details before arrival. <<FACT F057>> We also suggest allowing extra space for leash handling, water breaks, and quick checks by staff. Small preparations can make a big difference for the animal and for the journey.

If you need help with any pet travel plan, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
